svg.title: Kidney
svg.desc: A section through an idealised adult human kidney shows cortical tissue, medullary pyramids and the opened collecting system. Selected hilar vessels are retained.
svg.text: Coronal section with the collecting system opened

text.tspan: Illustrative coronal section. Calyces and renal pelvis are opened to show their continuity. Selected vessels only; not to scale.
Anatomical reference: OpenStax, Anatomy and Physiology 2e, section 25.3.
